decisions.statement: A page type is handed to the mechanical change taking a property off one.
The part and the declaration are that change's one answer.
A property no page type declares after this goes in the same landing.
A refusal from that change is the refusal this act gives.
The generator writes the page type's own type again from what this leaves.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
No change but that one rung is reached.

definition: one page property taken off one page type
